chunks: Herein are really signs for those who discern.

key_terms.لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ: for those who discern or observe closely

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be among those who discern (al-mutawassimin) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores that divine signs are not merely historical records but active indicators for the 'mutawassimin'—those who observe with deep spiritual insight to discern God's will in worldly affairs. It connects the physical observation of events with the intellectual and spiritual capacity to interpret them as manifestations of divine power, a concept central to understanding the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as guides who possess this heightened discernment.
